issues.title: Order total is off by a cent on some orders
issues.body: `orders/total.py` sums floats and rounds with `round`, so 3 × 0.35 gives 1.05 on one order and 1.04 on another. Done when the total rounds half up, in Decimal.

issues.title: Export the orders of a month as CSV
issues.body: The shop owner needs the orders of a month as a CSV file: order, customer, total.

issues.title: Dark mode for the admin pages
issues.body: The admin pages have only a light theme.

issues.title: The docstring of vat says cents, but it returns euros
issues.body:
`billing/tax.py:4`: the docstring of `vat` says "Returns the VAT on amount, in cents." The function returns euros, as a `Decimal` quantized to `0.01`. Its only caller, `get_invoice_total` in `billing/invoice.py:5`, adds the result to an order total in euros.

Fix: change the docstring to say that the result is in euros.

Found in the review of the branch for #14; out of scope there, because `billing/` is not the module of that task.

issues.title: sign_up treats emails that differ only in case as two accounts
issues.body:
`accounts/signup.py:4`: `sign_up` checks and stores the email as typed. So `Bob@shop.test` and `bob@shop.test` sign up as two accounts for one mailbox.

Expected: an email that differs only in case is refused with "this email has an account". A fix normalises the email (for example `strip()` and `casefold()`) before the check and the store, with a test for the case above.

Found in the review of the branch for #14; out of scope there, because `accounts/` is not the module of that task.

issues.title: An unknown coupon code crashes the checkout with a 500
issues.body:
`billing/coupon.py:5`: `discount_percent` reads `COUPONS[code]`, so a code that is not in `COUPONS` raises `KeyError`. `apply_coupon` in `api/checkout.py:5` does not catch it, so an unknown or mistyped coupon code crashes the checkout with a 500.

Expected: an unknown code gives a client error, not a crash. To decide: does the API answer a 4xx such as 400 / 422 with a message, or a discount of 0? Add a test with an unknown code.

Found in the review of the branch for #14; out of scope there, because `billing/` and `api/` are not the module of that task.
